given: A SKU's stock record carries a tracking code
when: The team member views that SKU's detail
then: The record's tracking code is displayed alongside its location detail
architectural_notes: E2E: the tracking code is the stock_records.inventory_code field carried on the domain model (app/models), surfaced by the stock-repository, mapped into the detail DTO by stock-service, and rendered per record by the React detail page. Owner module: domain model owns the field, stock-service owns the DTO shape presented to the boundary. Covered by PI2 (inventory_code NOT NULL) so a filed record always carries the value; asserted round-trip against the paired branch. No cross-cutting concern beyond field projection.

independence.rationale: AC1/AC2 assert which locations and which SKU's records appear; AC3 asserts a distinct field, the tracking code, is shown for a record. A build could list the correct locations and quantities (AC1/AC2 green) while omitting the tracking code column entirely (AC3 red).
